SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_boats,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(AVG(anglers), 1) as avg_anglers
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 200

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_boats,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 245 AND fish_date_doy <= 305
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
